note: What each delivery platform's own partner policy says about food hygiene ratings. Only a first-party source counts as verified. Where we could not read the platform's own policy page, the entry stays unverified and the page says so. Rescore never claims to know how a platform will decide.

platforms.name: Deliveroo
platforms.statedPosition: An FSA hygiene rating of at least 2 is needed to list on Deliveroo, unless the business falls within an exception in the policy.
platforms.belowMinimum: The policy sets out a route for a partner rated 1: engage an independent third-party food safety provider for a desktop consultation or an onsite audit at their own cost, or decline that and wait for the local authority re-inspection. A partner who does neither in time, or who does not reach at least a 2 at the next inspection, faces suspension until the rating improves.
platforms.partnerContact: Your partner manager, or partner support in the Deliveroo partner hub.
platforms.whatToSend: The evidence pack, the re-visit request receipt and the dated photos, so your partner manager can see the work is done and a re-visit is booked.

platforms.statedPosition: We could not read a minimum rating from Uber Eats' own partner policy pages on the date checked. Third-party guides commonly report a minimum of 3 in most areas, but that is not a source Rescore will state as fact.
platforms.belowMinimum: Unknown from a first-party source. Ask your partner manager what applies to your listing.
platforms.partnerContact: Your Uber Eats partner manager, or restaurant support in Uber Eats Manager.
platforms.whatToSend: The evidence pack, the re-visit request receipt and the dated photos.
